Location moves

Simulate every confirmed order between two dates. Medicines and anything already in a drug room stay there. The packing zone is not a stock location. Moves are planned together: a product that loses its bin moves into a location that the same plan leaves free. Suggestions are not written back to Odoo. The warehouse then shows a heat map of the most and least picked items. AI assistance asks the saved ChatGPT connection for a rearrangement and picking ideas.

    Timing assumptions

    Downstairs levels 02 and above include ladder time. Upstairs shelves never require ladders. This first version charges it per pick; shared ladder setups are not yet modelled.

    Layout & model notes

    Aisles 4–8 are dead ends. All paths are two-way. Drugs 10–13 can only be reached via the top of aisle 9. Runs start and finish at packing.

    Aisle 4: RA–RM; aisles 5–8: LA–LE / RA–RE; aisle 9: LA–LI / RA–RF. Bottom B storage and the three top-left blocks are included.

    Bay dimensions and shelf heights are illustrative. Small storage, B storage and drugs rooms are single pick points pending more detail. Mezzanine aisles 11–19 follow the supplied blue cross-walkways; A starts at the top. Aisle 19 has left shelving only. Upstairs shelf heights are illustrative and all reachable. The central floor cutout is preserved. Upstairs 20, 21, 22 and 25 are open storage zones to the right, not racks. FA codes are at the corresponding aisle front. 00 codes are at the nearest relevant aisle front; unidentifiable aisles use 4 downstairs or 11 upstairs. Other special locations sit beside packing. These added positions are approximate. No congestion, stock quantities or product relocation optimisation yet.

    Upstairs sections: 11 LA–LI / RA–RG; 12 LA–LG / RA–RH; 13 LA–LH / RA–RH; 14 LA–LH / RA–RC; 15–17 LA–LC / RA–RC; 18 LA–LC / RA–RS; 19 LA–LR. Front FA and bottom B storage included.

    The stair flight and its 6 m rise are estimated. Floor views change visibility only, not simulation routes. Select Follow picker for automatic floor switching.

    This is a standalone front-end prototype for later integration into Laravel/Livewire.
